inlines.v: EJEC'TION, noun [Latin ejectio.] The act of casting out; expulsion. 1. Dismission from office. 2. Dispossession; a turning out from possession by force or authority. 3. The discharge of any excrementitious matter through the pores or other emunctories; evacuation; vomiting. 4. Rejection.
